newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-LIST OF ITALIAN GOALSCORING MILESTONES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIST OF ITALIAN GOALSCORING MILESTONES.

text.p: The following is a list of goalscoring milestones in Italy's soccer history after Christian Vieri scored his country's 1,000th international goal during a World Cup qualifier against Moldova on Saturday:
1 - First goal scored by Pietro Lana, on May 15 1910 in Milan in a 6-2 victory over France. Lana scored in the 13th minute and went on to complete a hat-trick.
100 - Adolfo Baloncieri, January 30 1927 in the 16th minute of a 5-1 friendly victory against Switzerland in Geneva.
200 - Raimondo Orsi, December 13 1931 in 3-2 victory over Hungary in Turin.
300 - Giancarlo Pasinati, May 15 1938, in 6-1 friendly win against Belgium in Milan.
400 - Ermes Muccinelli, March 5 1950, in a 3-1 win against Belgium in Bologna.
500 - Mario Corso, November 11 1961, in a 6-0 victory over Israel in Turin.
600 - Pietro Anastasi, June 10 1968, in a 2-0 victory over Yugoslavia in Rome.
700 - Francesco Graziani, September 25 1976, in a 3-0 win against Yugoslavia in Rome.
800 - Paolo Rossi, February 4 1984, in a 5-0 victory against Mexico in Rome.
900 - Salvatore Schillaci, June 5 1991, in a 2-1 defeat by Norway in Oslo.
